name: Beats By LOR - Her Hair #0
description:
" Her Hair " is a song in hip-hop / Lofi style, which is made with great precision and elegance, Lofi style does not have a long life and its fans and popularity are added day by day, Her Hair, which is also made in the same style, It can be used for relaxation, focus, study and etc, which has a great effect in these cases. 
In addition, " Her Hair " is also a hip-hop beat, which can be implemented as a text and used as a hip-hop beat.
For this song, 6 layers of guitar (electric, acoustic), cello, string orchestra, piano, flute and female vocals have been recorded with high quality.
I've just come across This Platform which I think is an amazing platform, and this is the first song I'm putting out on this platform, it's available in very limited editions and at a very affordable price, I hope you get it. If you like it, let me know if you have any questions, I will be happy to help you.
All the layers of this song with the highest quality are available for you to apply your desired changes on it.
To know more about me and listen to my works, you can visit my Spotify link and my Instagram pages.
Please Support me, 
Thank you so much.
